'''M4-Y6''' was a small [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]].

==Behind the scenes==
The M4-Y6 Astromech Droid was a gift given to all players through their mailbox in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a gift for Star Wars Day starting on [[May 4]], [[2017]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
